name: io.github.serafxy/netease-mail-mcp
title: NetEase Mail
description: NetEase personal mail (163/126/yeah.net/188): search, read, draft, send with confirmation.

environmentVariables.name: NETEASE_MAIL_ACCOUNTS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated NetEase addresses to use (first is the default). Authorization codes are stored by `setup` in the OS keychain, not here. Overrides the config file.

environmentVariables.name: NETEASE_MAIL_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Permission mode: readonly, draft or full.

environmentVariables.name: NETEASE_MAIL_CONFIRM
environmentVariables.description: How send/move/trash are confirmed: auto, elicit (MCP elicitation, human approves in the client) or token (single-use content-bound token).
